    fullFibre v ⊆ closure (polarFibre v)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  intro ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨c,hc,ht,hρ⟩ := hρ
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨ell,s,hs,hsep⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed
    (polarFibre_convex v).closure isClosed_closure hn
  let T : PolarSource → LogIndex →₀ ℝ := fun p => logVector p.1
  let D : PolarSource → ℝ := fun p => ell (densityL1 p.1)
  have hcost : ∀ d : PolarSource →₀ ℝ, (∀ p, 0 ≤ d p) →
      linearCombination ℝ T d = v → s ≤ linearCombination ℝ D d := by
    intro d hd htd
    have he := (hsep (linearCombination ℝ (fun p : PolarSource => densityL1 p.1) d)
      (subset_closure ⟨d,hd,htd,rfl⟩)).le
    have hmap := Finsupp.apply_linearCombination ℝ ell.toLinearMap
      (fun p : PolarSource => densityL1 p.1) d
    change ell (linearCombination ℝ (fun p : PolarSource => densityL1 p.1) d) =
      linearCombination ℝ D d at hmap
    rwa [hmap] at he
  obtain ⟨b,hbv,hb⟩ := support_fibre T D
    (fun j => ⟨coordinateSource j (-1),coordinateSource_trace j (-1)⟩)
    (fun j => ⟨coordinateSource j 1,coordinateSource_trace j 1⟩)
    v s (trace_reachable v) hcost
  have hfull := full_pairing_bound b ell hb
  have hsum : linearCombination ℝ (fun f => linearCombination ℝ b (logVector f)) c ≤
      linearCombination ℝ (fun f => ell (densityL1 f)) c := by
    simp only [linearCombination_apply,Finsupp.sum,smul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun f _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfull f) (hc f)
  have hl := Finsupp.apply_linearCombination ℝ (linearCombination ℝ b) logVector c
  have hr := Finsupp.apply_linearCombination ℝ ell.toLinearMap densityL1 c
  change linearCombination ℝ b (linearCombination ℝ logVector c) =
    linearCombination ℝ (fun f => linearCombination ℝ b (logVector f)) c at hl
  change ell (linearCombination ℝ densityL1 c) =
    linearCombination ℝ (fun f => ell (densityL1 f)) c at hr
  rw [← hl,← hr,ht,hρ] at hsum
  linarith

    (a : ComplexNullMixture) (δ : ℝ≥0) :

        (𝓝 (spectralRepresentingMeasure a)) ∧
      ∀ n, energy (c n).1.1 = energy a.1.1 + δ
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  let A := energy a.1.1
  choose b hb using fun n : ℕ => exists_complexNullMixture_energy_gt
    (A + ((n : ℝ)+1)*δ + 1)
  have hD (n : ℕ) : 0 < energy (b n).1.1 - A := by
    have := hb n
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hd := δ.coe_nonneg
    nlinarith
  have hδ (n : ℕ) : (δ : ℝ) ≤ energy (b n).1.1 - A := by
    have := hb n
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hd := δ.coe_nonneg
    nlinarith
  let t (n : ℕ) : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨(δ : ℝ)/(energy (b n).1.1-A), div_nonneg δ.coe_nonneg (hD n).le,
      (div_le_one (hD n)).mpr (hδ n)⟩
  have htbound (n : ℕ) : (t n).1 ≤ 1/((n : ℝ)+1) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (hD n) (by positivity)).mpr
    have := hb n
    nlinarith
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => (t n).1) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => (t n).2.1) htbound tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  refine ⟨fun n => paperComplexNullSegment a (b n) (t n),
    tendsto_spectralRepresentingMeasure_admixture_of_weight_tendsto_zero a b t ht, ?_⟩
  intro n
  change energy (paperNormalizedSegment a.1 (b n).1 (t n)).1 = _
  rw [paperNormalizedSegment_observe]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have he : (t n).1 * (energy (b n).1.1 - A) = δ :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hD n).ne'
  dsimp only [A] at he
  nlinarith only [he]
